description: The few things Aeris Core needs that normal extensions can't do.

functions.name: setChromeStyle
functions.description: Restyle the browser frame (tabs, toolbar) with this CSS, replacing the last one. Empty clears it.

functions.name: setNewTabPage
functions.description: Use this page for new tabs and the home page.

functions.name: appInfo
functions.description: Aeris and Firefox version numbers.

functions.name: readAeroExport
functions.description: The bookmarks, apps and settings Aero saved for Aeris, or null.

functions.name: importAeroPasswords
functions.description: Moves Aero's saved passwords into Aeris's password manager. Returns how many were added.

functions.name: installAddon
functions.description: Install an add-on bundled inside Aeris Core (a path inside this extension) or one from addons.mozilla.org (its download address).

functions.name: openBrowserPage
functions.description: Open one of Firefox's own pages (settings, add-ons, passwords) in a new tab.

functions.name: addonInfo
functions.description: Whether these add-ons are installed, their version, and the address of their app page.

functions.name: downloadUpdate
functions.description: Download a newer Aeris installer from GitHub; it installs quietly when you close Aeris.

functions.name: getPrefs
functions.description: Read some of Firefox's settings (only the ones Customize uses).

functions.name: setPrefs
functions.description: Change some of Firefox's settings (only the ones Customize uses).

functions.name: searchEngines
functions.description: The search engines, and which one is used.

functions.name: makeDefaultBrowser
functions.description: Opens Windows' default-apps settings with Aeris picked (Windows asks you to confirm).

functions.name: openImportWizard
functions.description: Firefox's 'bring your bookmarks and passwords from another browser' window.

functions.name: openLibrary
functions.description: The bookmarks library (to import or export bookmarks as a file).

functions.name: setTabStacking
functions.description: Turn tab stacking on or off: a + on each tab opens a new tab under it.

functions.name: memoryUsage
functions.description: How much memory (MB) all of Aeris's processes use together.

functions.name: toolbarButtons
functions.description: Which of these Firefox toolbar buttons are on the toolbar.

functions.name: setToolbarButton
functions.description: Put one of Firefox's own buttons (Forget, Screenshot) on the toolbar, or take it off.

functions.name: openQuickCommands
functions.description: Open Quick Commands over the page. Extra commands are sent back through onCommand.

functions.name: openCustomizeToolbar
functions.description: Firefox's toolbar editor, to move or remove buttons.

functions.name: setPagesStyle
functions.description: Restyle Firefox's own pages (Settings, Add-ons…) with this CSS; empty turns it off.

events.name: onCommand
events.description: A command picked in Quick Commands that Aeris Core carries out.
